identity_and_current_site.provider: Kappa Kappa Gamma Gamma Delta official chapter website
identity_and_current_site.observation: Confirms active Gamma Delta chapter and current chapter site, but presents generic housing copy and no identifiable current house exterior/interior photograph or plan.

exterior_photo.provider: Purdue Student Life, official Flickr account
observations: Large multi-wing residence in a landscaped courtyard setting.
Pale cream/gray Rostone or stone-like ashlar facade with horizontal joint pattern.
Dark blue louvered shutters at repeated sash windows.
Large blue-green multicolored slate/mansard roof with several small dormers.
Courtyard-facing entry in the long inner wall, with KKG lettering above the threshold.
Building mass wraps around the planted entry court.
A standalone chapter sign sits in the courtyard; omitted from the building-only asset.
exterior_photo.limits: Best official identifiable exterior source found, but nine years old as of retrieval; not georeferenced and does not establish exact facade direction, dimensions, or current condition.

site_plan.observation: Plan labels the Kappa Kappa Gamma Sorority property at 325 Waldron Street.
site_plan.limits: Adjacent redevelopment drawing used only to corroborate address/site identity; it is not an elevation or interior plan.
